purpose: Development PIMC feasibility and reference agreement, not independent strength acceptance

selection.sample: First semantic-plan top2 Q gap <0.15 after at least eight plies, at most one position per deal; finish each deal for dispute-frequency denominator
selection.scope: Self-play simulated positions only; not representative human positions

referenceNote: With raw argmax and an identical true deal, 48 identical determinations are deterministic repeats with effective unique world count 1. Memoize identical worlds and report requested/effective counts; no 48-independent-sample uncertainty claim. Full-information greedy continuation is not an optimal-play oracle.
roots: Champion semantic-deduplicated top3, plus pass and legal immediate finishes; no hand tactical scores
continuation: Unchanged champion raw argmax, no finishing shortcut, common worlds for all roots, complete single round only; truncation/STOP is error, never leaf bootstrap or draw
phaseB: Optional public-history softmax log-likelihood with T>=0.2; report ESS before resampling and distinct survivors, never claim resampling creates information

acceptance.greedy: Per-root trace and outcome equal to priorWeight=0 direct oracle rollout in raw mode
acceptance.agreement: All 200 completed; belief agreement with deterministic full-information reference strictly exceeds raw argmax agreement; clustered difference reported; no promotion
acceptance.timing: Measure every uniform-search call: count, mean, median, p95, max; <=3s is a target, not assumed
acceptance.incomplete: Block 0.4 if acceptance or completeness fails; report partial result

devicePlan: One bounded DirectML inference worker plus Node game logic; CPU fallback recorded; no gradient updates
seedStatus: Fresh development deals audited before start; separate future independent search pilot seeds
sourceStatus: Freeze exact files/commit before launching preregistered pilot
